statements.name: provenance
statements.sql: INSERT INTO legal_text_provenance (source, source_id, source_url, article_id, action, previous_text, created_at) SELECT 'hakeem', 'hkm030-heading-strip-2026-10-19', 'internal:hakeem/legal_articles/'||id, id, 'heading_strip', content, now() FROM legal_articles WHERE "articleBis" < 100 AND content ~ '^\s*المادة\s'

statements.name: strip
statements.sql: UPDATE legal_articles SET content = regexp_replace(content, '^\s*المادة\s[^\n:]{1,45}?\s*(?:[:：]\s*|\n\s*)', ''), "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "articleBis" < 100 AND content ~ '^\s*المادة\s'

statements.name: search_norm
statements.sql: UPDATE legal_articles a SET search_norm = uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm(a."lawName", a.title, a.content, a.keywords, a.classification, a.chapter) WHERE a.id IN (SELECT article_id FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source_id = 'hkm030-heading-strip-2026-10-19') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id = a.id AND v.valid_from <= now())
